messages:
jen: Customer reported a huge overnight balance drop, says free-trial promo never applied and their hourly ingest kept burning tokens.
maria: Account acme-inc (acct_id: 4321). They signed up, expected 1k free credits from promo P-APRIL but support logs show promo attach failed at signup (400 from billing API).
sam: I pulled the ingest logs — their Airflow job hits /v1/embeddings with a batch size of 512 at 02:00 UTC. Around that time we responded with 500 then client retried. Retries were billed each attempt.
jen: can you paste the request ids + statuses? customer says retries were automatic and rapid.
sam: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-10T02:00:01Z r=rid-0a1 POST /v1/embeddings 500  x-token-burn=512
2026-03-10T02:00:03Z r=rid-0a1 RETRY POST /v1/embeddings 200 x-token-burn=512
2026-03-10T02:00:03Z r=rid-0a2 POST /v1/embeddings 200 x-token-burn=512
```
Note: their client does parallel retries without idempotency key, so same payload billed multiple times.
jordan: :eyes: Billing shows applied promo credit = 0 for acct 4321, free_trial_grant never created. There is an error in our promo-service logs: `wallet.create_grant: 422 invalid promo code` at signup time.
maria: customer supplied P-APRIL and email matches allowlist. Looks like a transient validation bug — promo-service returned 422 because coupon status was stale in cache.
ingest-bot: alert: embedding queue spiked due to backoff jitter. retried_requests=8 failed_then_success=6
jen: Proposed remediation: 1) Manually add free trial grant of 1000 tokens to acct 4321 asap. 2) Refund billed tokens from the retry window (02:00-02:10) — estimate ~6 batches * 512 tokens = 3072 tokens. 3) Fix promo-service cache TTL + add idempotency check for incoming embedding requests so retries with same payload/req-id aren't double-billed.
maria: I've queued a manual grant and flagged billing for refund. Support case updated and customer notified.
sam: For repro steps: run the hourly job with no idempotency key while forcing a 500 on first call. Confirm we currently bill every successful retry separately.
jen: Thanks — please DM me the refund ticket number once created. I'll follow up with the engineering postmortem and assign to eng-runtime to add dedupe logic. :thumbsup:
jordan: follow-up: added a short-term guard in quota service to not deduct for requests with identical idempotency tokens seen in last 30s. Will propose longer-term KV-cache for promo validity.
maria: customer acknowledged and thanked us. Closing loop once refund processed.
